description:
Reference values for the unit tests of a new implementation (Chapter 8.8, Chapter 9.7).

Units: those of Posidonius -- AU, day, M_sun, G = G_Mercury (constants.rs), spin in rad/day.
Love-number spectra: analytic functions of the PHYSICAL frequency chi in rad/s (as the Posidonius input
files), converted from the forcing frequency sigma in rad/day by chi = |sigma| / DAY.
Each case gives the inputs (r = r_p - r_star, v, spin s, masses, radius, mean rates) and the expected
outputs F_{star->p} (M_sun AU day^-2) and dL_spin/dt = -r x F (M_sun AU^2 day^-2), with the truncation
|q| <= q_max(e) of the tol-1e-5 table (reference row, 2026-10-28) and with |q| <= 70 (converged to 1e-15).

Output: ../reference_values/kaula_l2_reference_cases.json

conventions.force: F_{star->planet}, inertial axes; applied +F/M_p to the planet, -F/M_star to the star
conventions.torque: dL_spin/dt = -r x F, r = r_planet - r_star
conventions.love_number: bar k2(sigma) = rek2(|sigma|) - i sgn(sigma) imk2(|sigma|), imk2 >= 0 = lag
conventions.frequency: sigma_2mpq = (2-2p) lamdot + q nbar + (m-2+2p) Omdot - m Omega_p

cases.notes: closed form of Section 5.6; independent of the node and pericentre

love_number_spectrum.formula: rek2 = k2 cos(chi dt), imk2 = k2 sin(chi dt), chi in rad/s
